author: m0_ox
content:
🧪  `heze-devnet@v3.0.0`: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-heze-devnet@v3.0.0

First release for `heze-devnet-3`, **on the EL side** from [`devnets/heze/3`](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/devnets/heze/3), per the [devnet spec](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/heze-devnet-3).
- EIP-8198 is back. The base fee max change follows slot timing, `min(seconds, 12·slots) / (96·slots)`, so `3/32` at 9 s slots, and slot numbers must increase ([EIPs#12552](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12552)).
- Bogota keeps Amsterdam's blob schedule. The devnet's 11/17 BPO comes from the genesis config, not these fixtures.
- EIP-7805: unchanged since v2.0.1.

Thanks <@412614104222531604> for aligning on the EIP-8198 changes to the EIP and specs.
